messages:
Aisha: Heads-up — while linking the new tracing explainer from the runtime guide I hit a 404 on the observability anchor: https://docs.redwood.inference/observability/tracing#span-ids. Rendering shows the page but the #span-ids fragment doesn't exist.
Tom: hmm, I can repro. Looks like the heading changed from `Span IDs` to `Trace identifiers` in the recent rewrite.
Aisha: Ah ok. Can we either restore the old anchor or add a redirect/alias? This is hitting a handful of runtime guide examples and one onboarding notebook.
Sophie: @Tom good catch. Whoever owns that page — can you either add an HTML anchor or add an alias in frontmatter? Adding frontmatter alias is safest so external links keep working.
Tom: I can do a tiny PR. Plan: add `aliases` to the tracing doc frontmatter and update any hard links that point to `#span-ids`.
Kai: If you're updating links, there are 3 internal refs I found with ripgrep: `runtime/**/*tracing*`, `handbook/onboarding/*notebook*`, and one in `examples/observability/demo.ipynb`.
Aisha: Nice. For the docs patch could you include this sed snippet so ops can run a one-liner if needed? (tested locally)

```
# add alias to top of file frontmatter
perl -0777 -pe "s/^(---\n)(.*?)(\n---)/$1$2\naliases:\n  - \"/observability/tracing#span-ids\"\n$3/s" -i observability/tracing.md
```

Tom: That looks fine. I'll open a PR with the frontmatter change + update the 3 link occurrences. Pinging @Sophie for a quick CR when done.
Sophie: happy to review — will check for any JS link generation side-effects.
Aisha: If it's tiny we can do fast-track. Also, can we attach a short changelog note so QA knows the anchor change was backwards-compatible? Something like: `docs: add alias for old tracing anchor (#PR)`
Tom: Yep adding changelog and test case in the notebook that asserts link resolves.
Sophie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — small frontmatter + updates. @docs-bot can you run link-checker for `observability/tracing.md` on that PR?
docs-bot: Link-checker queued for PR 2345 :white_check_mark: — will post results here when done.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. Assigning ownership for followups to Tom for 48h to make sure the examples are green.
Tom: Got it. I'll merge once CI/link-check passes. :rocket:
